question: ¿Cuántas publicaciones del conjunto, cada una contada una vez, nombran al CONICET (organización ROR https://ror.org/03cqe8w59) en al menos una afiliación? No se suman las de sus institutos. Una afiliación nombra a una organización cuando su texto contiene el nombre de la organización, un nombre o alias que registra ROR, o una sigla que en ROR usa solo esa organización argentina.

attempts.query:
WITH conicet_names AS (
  SELECT n.value
  FROM ror.name n
  WHERE n.id = 'https://ror.org/03cqe8w59'
    AND (n.types LIKE '%ror_display%' OR n.types LIKE '%label%' OR n.types LIKE '%alias%')
),
ar_orgs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id FROM ror.location WHERE country_code = 'AR'
),
conicet_acronyms AS (
  SELECT n.value
  FROM ror.name n
  WHERE n.id = 'https://ror.org/03cqe8w59'
    AND n.types LIKE '%acronym%'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ror.name n2
      JOIN ar_orgs a ON a.id = n2.id
      WHERE n2.types LIKE '%acronym%'
        AND upper(n2.value) = upper(n.value)
        AND n2.id <> n.id
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT af.doi)
FROM crossref.affiliation af
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM conicet_names cn
    WHERE position(lower(cn.value) IN lower(af.name)) > 0
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM conicet_acronyms ca
    WHERE af.name ~ ('(^|[^[:alnum:]])' || regexp_replace(ca.value, '([.^$*+?()\[\]{}|\\-])', '\\\1', 'g') || '($|[^[:alnum:]])')
  )
attempts.error: canceling statement due to statement timeout

attempts.query:
WITH ar_orgs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT id FROM ror.location WHERE country_code = 'AR'
),
conicet AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT value, types FROM ror.name WHERE id = 'https://ror.org/03cqe8w59'
),
other_ar_acr AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT upper(n.value) AS v
  FROM ror.name n JOIN ar_orgs a ON a.id = n.id
  WHERE n.types LIKE '%acronym%' AND n.id <> 'https://ror.org/03cqe8w59'
),
patterns AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT lower(value) AS name_pat, NULL::text AS acr_pat
  FROM conicet
  WHERE types LIKE '%ror_display%' OR types LIKE '%label%' OR types LIKE '%alias%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, '(^|[^[:alnum:]])' || regexp_replace(c.value, '([.^$*+?()\[\]{}|\\-])', '\\\1', 'g') || '($|[^[:alnum:]])'
  FROM conicet c
  WHERE c.types LIKE '%acronym%'
    AND upper(c.value) NOT IN (SELECT v FROM other_ar_acr)
),
texts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT name FROM crossref.affiliation WHERE name IS NOT NULL
),
matching AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT t.name
  FROM texts t
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM patterns p
    WHERE (p.name_pat IS NOT NULL AND position(p.name_pat IN lower(t.name)) > 0)
       OR (p.acr_pat IS NOT NULL AND t.name ~ p.acr_pat)
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT af.doi)
FROM crossref.affiliation af
JOIN matching m ON m.name = af.name
